correctness.rationale: Taking logs of exact swap equations forces 0<a<1 and gives unique z>0 with strictly increasing rho(z,a). The one-step Jacobian M and coordinate swap P yield exact monodromy (PM)^2. Two strict Jury inequalities are algebraically equivalent to z>z_-(a) and z<z_+(a), each boundary unique by proven C,J,A monotonicities. The two inequalities overlap iff a<a_*, with a_* the unique crossing of strictly opposed scalar curves. The exact witness at a=1/10 and z=log4 has rigorous rational lower bounds for both strict Jury inequalities, as checked by a standalone script; sampling is not substituted for the analytic all-parameter argument.

value.rationale: Antiphase exchange of abundances is a naturally motivated biological dynamical mode explicitly studied in the cited Ricker competition papers. The theorem distinguishes existence from attraction and obtains a unique maximal interspecific competition strength together with the exact entire attraction wedge and endpoint spectral mechanisms. That structural parameter classification is meaningful for interpreting numerical phase-multistability diagrams, not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice. No claims about global basins, other cycles or empirical ecology are made.
